A future existing-system link must distinguish acquisition requirement from actual origin, and must not grant another weapon.

findings.actual: cod1 requires ten spirits guided at abandoned mortuary altar; cod2 gives banner at river-ferry dragon-pattern stone after dungeon boss. Both cannot independently issue the same unique reward without a shared owner.
findings.task_link: Retain both source requirements pending a single shared qualification/grant integration. Do not duplicate delivery or erase either original requirement merely because a generic banner exists.
